* **Samsung Health:** skip empty c6r fingerprint on Health 7.x ([036254a](https://github.com/bigyank/morphe-patches-samsung/commit/036254a6ad640248db59b7e07c038c1e5fb7046a))

patches.name: Bypass Samsung Account provider checks
patches.description: Replaces com.osp.app.signin with com.notsamsung.dummy in dex and routes account lookups through Android AccountManager instead of Samsung Account's provider.

patches.name: Disable Knox integrity checks
patches.description: Bypass Knox, root, warranty bit, and SAK checks so Samsung Health runs on Knox-tripped devices (0x1) without root.
